title: Measure output-prose's actual token savings
Investigate bimodal total-output response to output-prose

reason: Measured and published 2026-08-04. Prose output reduction median 92.5% (95% CI 59.3-97.8%, n=5 pairs, Sonnet, synthetic fixture, headless -p); whole-session output reduction 22.4% derived via a 24.3% prose share measured over 81 real sessions. Figures and their scope are in packages/cli/README.md, CONVENTIONS.md section 10, and benchmarks/README.md. Harness at benchmarks/ is re-runnable. Phase 4 returned NO-GO on a larger study: reaching a +/-5pp interval needs ~468 sessions, and the remaining uncertainty is in the derivation's assumption rather than the sample size. Bimodal total-output response split out as AGENTKIT-c8bf2f.
